verdict.rationale: Puzzle's first-party AI Close feature is described as using AI agents to reconcile accounts, review transactions, and surface discrepancies during month-end close. Separate docs say automated work like matching invoices to payments is reviewed by the user before anything is final, which covers matching, exception flagging, and human review at a headline level. missing for 10: detailed documentation of the AI Close end-to-end workflow (how matching and exception handling actually run, what close package is produced for review), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent reconcile a month end-to-end, matching transactions, flagging exceptions, and preparing the close for human review

citations.quote: AI Close helps you automate and accelerate your month-end process using AI agents to reconcile accounts, review transactions, and surface discrepancies.
matching invoices to payments, pulling together what your accountant needs — described once, done automatically, reviewed by you before anything's final.
